scope_note: This addendum writes NO implementation and allocates NO migration ordinal. It changes exactly one function in scripts/ods-scope.ts - the PROTECTED_GRANTS registry - and nothing else in that file.

lineage_derivation.method: Derived mechanically AFTER Controller 25 -> 26 closed, by sweeping every remote head and the full commit history - never assumed.
lineage_derivation.w2_17_collision_check: HPO-ODS-W2-17 occurs at INTEGRATION_SHA in exactly two places, both inside ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.15.json controller_sequencing_rule, where it NAMES the allocation that was forbidden while the v1.0.15 enumeration gap stood open. It is never a GRANT_ID and never an authorityId in scripts/ods-scope.ts. It was unallocated, and the prohibition that named it is discharged by its own terms now that Controller 26 is integrated.
lineage_derivation.predecessor_sequencing_rule_satisfied: ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.15.json required Controller 25 -> 26 to be materialized, audited AND integrated before any further ODS lineage item is allocated. All three happened before this artifact was written.

FUNCTION_A_PROTECTED_GRANT.why: All three match DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS in scripts/ods-scope.ts (db/migrations/** entry 4 and db/prepared/** entry 5, both unchanged by this addendum) and are therefore unconditionally protected absent a resolved grant.
FUNCTION_A_PROTECTED_GRANT.measured_necessity_pattern_1_and_2: FIBIU-17 and FIBIU-18 each register one new Drizzle migration with its meta snapshot and its _journal.json append, and each receives a db/prepared/journal wrapper generated by pnpm journal:generate. Baseline growth additionally rewrites the generated 'Unit N/TOTAL' header of every existing wrapper.
FUNCTION_A_PROTECTED_GRANT.measured_necessity_pattern_3: B5 appends two governed baseline units, so the corpus that scripts/b0-observation-sql.ts reads gains three tables. That script's own header states it CONNECTS TO NOTHING - it reads the corpus and writes a file - and its verify mode reports the file DIVERGED from the corpus when stale, because rowCounts needs one arm per table the corpus creates. The generated probe is therefore stale by construction the moment B5 registers its units, and canonical regeneration is the only correct repair. This is the same mechanism, on the same file, that HPO-ODS-W2-16 addressed for W2-B4's 74 -> 76 growth.
FUNCTION_A_PROTECTED_GRANT.narrowness: Deliberately NOT db/prepared/**. That would reach every hosted and local bootstrap file the P1A and hosted lanes own, and would reach db/prepared/checkpoint-a1/corroboration.sql, which W2_B5_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json explicitly protects as a historical measurement. The third pattern is ONE exact literal path with no glob: db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/ holds exactly that one file, so even a directory pattern would grant strictly more than the classifier can justify.
FUNCTION_A_PROTECTED_GRANT.no_widening: HPO-ODS-W2-12 and HPO-ODS-W2-16 are FROZEN, are bound to branch codex/w2-b4-r1, and are neither widened, amended nor reused. resolveProtectedGrants unions only the ids a caller actually supplies.

FUNCTION_B_PRODUCT_TEST_INSTRUCTION.why_an_ODS_instruction_is_required: ODS_V1_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json prohibited_surfaces reserves existing product tests except where a future explicit ODS instruction authorizes a narrowly required adjustment. The B5 implementation must adjust a bounded, enumerated set of pre-existing product tests, and must create one new governance host.
FUNCTION_B_PRODUCT_TEST_INSTRUCTION.instruction_source_of_truth: docs/ops/wave2/W2_B5_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json ods_test_instructions.granted_paths, which enumerates each path together with the exact narrowly-required adjustment authorized on it.
FUNCTION_B_PRODUCT_TEST_INSTRUCTION.new_host_named_exactly: tests/w2-b5-governance.test.ts is enumerated by exact name in the B5 authority's new_tests.exact_new_hosts. W2-B4's closure audit classified tests/w2-b4-governance.test.ts as an UNAUTHORIZED PATH precisely because a new governance host matched no enumerated pattern under a closed world. That failure class is closed here.
FUNCTION_B_PRODUCT_TEST_INSTRUCTION.classification_caution: None of these paths is classified PROTECTED. Requiring an explicit ODS instruction is NOT the same as matching DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS. Neither lib/** nor tests/** nor app/** nor artifacts/** appears in DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS, so every one of them needs an ordinary --allow and NONE needs, nor receives, a protected grant. Only the three patterns in FUNCTION_A are protected.
FUNCTION_B_PRODUCT_TEST_INSTRUCTION.artifacts_are_not_protected: artifacts/hosted-a1-status.json and artifacts/baseline-rehearsal/latest.json are regenerated by B5 under the baseline-growth contract and need an ordinary --allow only.
FUNCTION_B_PRODUCT_TEST_INSTRUCTION.no_wildcard: No lib/**, tests/**, app/** or artifacts/** grant of any kind is created. A product test not enumerated in the B5 authority is a fresh STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_DELTA.

FUNCTION_C_CONTROLLER_SELF_ENUMERATION.measured_necessity: scripts/ods-controller.ts at INTEGRATION_SHA defines IMMUTABLE_BY_CONVENTION as an EXACT-membership closed world holding exactly 26 entries, all of them docs/ops/ods/ artifacts, and it does not contain this addendum. tests/ods/ods-controller.test.ts asserts length 26 and Set cardinality 26, and separately asserts that ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.16.json is NOT pre-included - an absence control that reserves no identifier and authorizes no grant.
FUNCTION_C_CONTROLLER_SELF_ENUMERATION.why_the_gap_is_bounded_and_safe: The absence control is an assertion about the enumeration ARRAY, not about the filesystem, and neither the Controller nor its test performs any filesystem discovery of docs/ops/ods/. Creating this addendum as a file therefore leaves that control passing and opens exactly ONE temporary enumeration gap - the same bounded pattern v1.0.10 through v1.0.15 each occupied.

controller_sequencing_rule.controller_27_does_not_block_b5_implemen: The W2-B5 implementation on branch codex/w2-b5-r1 MAY proceed and MAY merge while IMMUTABLE_BY_CONVENTION still holds 26, under the same bounded temporary-gap precedent that v1.0.10 through v1.0.15 each occupied, and which ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.15.json applied by name to W2-B4. The three preconditions are stated as conditions, not assumptions, and all are measured true at INTEGRATION_SHA: the B5 implementation consumes only the already-allocated HPO-ODS-W2-17 grant and the already-frozen B5 authority and allocates no lineage item; CONTROLLER_DB_EXECUTION is DISABLED; and no second ODS lineage gap is created by running them concurrently.
controller_27_must_close_before: any further ODS lineage allocation - that is, before any ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.17 or HPO-ODS-W2-18 is derived by any mission in any lane
controller_sequencing_rule.why_that_boundary: Allocating a second addendum while v1.0.16 is still unenumerated would open a SECOND simultaneous temporary gap. Every precedent gap has been single and immediately closed. Two concurrent gaps would make the live Controller count ambiguous as a precondition - a successor could no longer tell whether a live count of 26 means one gap open or two gaps open with one already counted - which is exactly the ambiguity the live-count precondition exists to prevent. Requiring closure before FINAL B5 closure additionally guarantees the batch never closes on top of an unenumerated governance artifact.
controller_sequencing_rule.enforcement: A mission that finds v1.0.16 unenumerated in the live Controller and attempts to allocate v1.0.17 or HPO-ODS-W2-18, or to declare W2-B5 closed, MUST STOP_FOR_LINEAGE_SEQUENCING rather than proceed.
controller_sequencing_rule.line_ceiling: The 400-line Controller ceiling from ODS_CONTROLLER_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json exit_criteria E1 remains in force. The file is 384 lines at INTEGRATION_SHA.
